content.thinking: The universe check in difftest2 is also wrong: universe should be product over all cells (slots × fields) = (prod of domain sizes)^slots. Let me fix both.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
p='tmp/gen2.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("refs = list({[s, g['name']] for s in range(slots)})[:slots]","refs = [[s, g['name']] for s in range(slots)]")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='tmp/difftest2.py'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""    universe=1
    for f in job['fields']: universe*=len(f['domain'])
    universe**=1
    cells=job['slots']*len(job['fields'])
    if universe>4096: continue""","""    universe=1
    for f in job['fields']: universe*=len(f['domain'])
    universe**=job['slots']
    if universe>2048 or len(job['predicates'])>7: continue""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
python3 tmp/difftest2.py 11 800 2>&1 | tail -12
